create_lms_scheduler: create an LMSDiscreteScheduler instance with linear beta schedule and 1000 training timesteps for diffusion model inference
set_timesteps: set the discrete timesteps for the LMSDiscreteScheduler by calling set_timesteps with the desired number of inference steps
step_denoising: call the step method on LMSDiscreteScheduler to predict the previous sample by reversing the SDE using model output and current timestep
scale_model_input: scale the denoising model input using scale_model_input before calling step to ensure correct denoising at the current timestep
add_noise: add noise to original samples using the add_noise method with a noise tensor and specified timesteps from the scheduler
